## Scope decisions taken by this scan (for deputy confirmation)

- Excluded as non-evidentiary tooling/cache directories (not walked, no register rows): `.git`, `.venv`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `.pytest_cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `__pycache__`, `.mplconfig` in both MNL and Job_Market_paper.
- Within `EUROMOD-STORAGE`, only the JMP output/staging/scratch/dev trees were walked in full: `outputs/`, `new_data/`, `old_outputs/`, `reports/`, `scratch/`. `Data/raw` was walked and listed (HOLD, DELETE-PROHIBITED per s8) as instructed. `Data/{processed,interim,external,pilot,inspecting}` and `Euromod_model/` were treated as out-of-scope generic EUROMOD input/software trees (not "JMP output trees") and were NOT walked -- flagged here rather than silently dropped; confirm scope with the Goal-1 Manager.
- `dclaborsupply-monorepo` (both the MNL gitlink checkout and the standalone clone) was scanned READ-ONLY for path references into MNL/Job_Market_paper only; it carries no inventory/disposition rows of its own, per ruling scope.
- Reference-repo resolution for extracted path strings that carried no explicit repo prefix defaulted to "try all three trees" (mnl/jmp/storage), which can over-protect (a coincidental relative-path match) but never under-protects -- consistent with the ruling's HOLD-by-default, protect-first posture.
- `canonical_successor` is left blank in the register except where a pin registry's own provenance text states an explicit supersession (e.g. `u6_stem_2x_mnlmeta_superseded_v1` -> `u6_stem_2x_mnlmeta`). No general supersession-map artifact exists on disk covering the wider `new_data/fr_p3a_bpool_*` version families; those chains are HOLD rather than guessed.
